people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: After this, Jesus, seeing that all things were now finished, that the Scripture might be fulfilled, said, “I am thirsty.”
translations.bsb: After this, knowing that everything had now been accomplished, and to fulfill the Scripture, Jesus said, “I am thirsty.”
translations.kjv: After this, Jesus knowing that all things were now accomplished, that the scripture might be fulfilled, saith, I thirst.
translations.asv: After this Jesus, knowing that all things are now finished, that the scripture might be accomplished, saith, I thirst.
